class Base {
  static label = 'base';
}
class Derived extends Base {}
const Bound = Derived.bind(null);
const Rebound = Bound.bind(null);
console.log(new Derived() instanceof Bound, new Bound() instanceof Rebound, Bound.label);
console.log(new Base() instanceof Rebound);

type Dictionary<K extends string> = { [P in K]: boolean };
const flags: Dictionary<string> = { ready: true };
const selected: Dictionary<'ready'> = flags;
const values: Record<string, number> = { answer: 42 };
const chosen: Record<'answer', number> = values;
console.log(selected.ready, chosen.answer);
